description: K₂NaMgVOF₅ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one O and six F atoms. The K-O bond length is 2.52 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.09 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and five F atoms. There is one shorter (2.92 Å) and one longer (2.94 Å) K-O bond length. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.92 Å. Na is bonded to one O and three F atoms to form distorted NaOF₃ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VOF₅ octahedra and corners with three equivalent MgOF₄ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-70°. The Na-O bond length is 2.25 Å. There is one shorter (2.16 Å) and two longer (2.18 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Mg is bonded to one O and four F atoms to form distorted MgOF₄ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent VOF₅ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaOF₃ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one VOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-17°. The Mg-O bond length is 1.92 Å. There are a spread of Mg-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.10 Å. V is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form VOF₅ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaOF₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgOF₄ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one MgOF₄ trigonal bipyramid. The V-O bond length is 2.15 Å. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.15 Å. O is bonded to three K, one Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted OK₃NaMgV octahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₃NaMgV octahedra, corners with two equivalent FK₃NaV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent FK₃NaV trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to three K, one Na, and one V atom to form distorted FK₃NaV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent OK₃NaMgV octahedra, corners with two equivalent FK₃NaV trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent OK₃NaMgV octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-62°.
